abstract: Banners read "Fighting for Our Lives," "Knock and It Will Be Opened. Matt. 7:8, Luke 11:10," and "New York Physicians for Human Rights." Signs read "Stop U.S. War in Central America & the Caribbean, Wash. D.C. July 2, Lesbian and Gay Contingent, $ to Fight Aids," "God Save the American Queens!," "My Gay Son is the Greatest!," "I'm Gay, Proud, and Angry!," "This Year: The Street," "AID for A.I.D.S. Now!," and "Government A.I.D.S. Go Away, Kill a Gay Another Day." T-shirt reads "i'm fighting for my life + your life + for a Couple of People I Haven't Met Yet." Balloons read "Closets are for clothing," "It's Our Day," and "It's a Gay Night Tonight."

title: Christopher Street [pride] parade 1981
topics: demonstrations; signs and signboards; civil rights; gay rights; gay men; lesbians; parades; LGBTQ+ people; LGBTQ+ activism; civil rights demonstrations
places: New York, New York, United States
abstract: Banners read "National Gay Task Force," "East Village Lesbian and Gay Neighbors," "GCN Gay Community News," "1981 12th Annual March and Rally 1981, A Commitment, A Movement, A Way of Life," "We Know That Nothing Can Separate Us from God's Love," "Sexual Freedom for All!," and "We Are Everywhere." Signs read "What history forgets we are doomed to repeat. Defeat the Moral Majority now!," "The original Stonewall Gang," "Grandma for Gays," "Put the Holy Ghost in the Closet," "Religion=Oppression," "Man-Boy Love," and "Stonewall Chorale."

topics: demonstrations; signs and signboards; civil rights; gay rights; gay men; lesbians; parades; LGBTQ+
places: New York, New York, United States
abstract: Banners read "Fighting for Our Lives," "Knock and It Will Be Opened. Matt. 7:8, Luke 11:10," and "New York Physicians for Human Rights." Signs read "Stop U.S. War in Central America & the Caribbean, Wash. D.C. July 2, Lesbian and Gay Contingent, $ to Fight Aids," "God Save the American Queens!," "My Gay Son is the Greatest!," "I'm Gay, Proud, and Angry!," "This Year: The Street," "AID for A.I.D.S. Now!," and "Government A.I.D.S. Go Away, Kill a Gay Another Day." T-shirt reads "i'm fighting for my life + your life + for a Couple of People I Haven't Met Yet." Balloons read "Closets are for clothing," "It's Our Day," and "It's a Gay Night Tonight."
